Name: Cheat Recipes
Author: exarobibliologist
Description:
There's no way to describe this other than to put the words cheat in all caps.

[size=5]THIS IS A CHEAT MOD!![/size]

[size=6]Please use [u]responsibly[/u]... or [i][u]not[/u][/i]![/size]

It adds recipes so that you can convert low-tier ores and materials into higher-tier ones, and vice-versa. You can upcycle Wood into lots of more valuable stuff!

The conversion is:
1 Wood = 1 Copper Ore
1 Copper Ore = 1 Iron Ore
1 Iron Ore = 1 Gold Ore
1 Gold Ore = 1 Iridium Ore
1 Iridium Ore = 1 Radioactive Ore
1 Radioactive Ore = 1 Cinder Shard
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Geode
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Frozen Geode
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Magma Geode
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Omni Geode
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Artifact Trove
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Prize Ticket
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Qi Gem
9 Cinder Shards = 1 Golden Walnut
99 Cinder Shards = 1 Galaxy Soul
99 Cinder Shards = 1 Stardrop

[b][i](SAY WHAT!?!? Yes, you can [u]craft [/u]a [u]Stardrop[/u]... Good deal? That's for you to decide.)

I haven't been able to get the codes for Mystery Boxes and Golden Mystery Boxes to work, but if I do that will be in the next update...[/i][/b]
